svg.title: DI01 One pole of the N42SH variant in 3D
svg.text: DI01 One pole of the N42SH variant (isometric), seen from the stator side
Five rows of bonded pairs on the drum seat, each row turned 0.20° further. Stepped comb bars either side.
Not drawn: glue, end rings, glass sleeve.
Rows step 0.20° = 1.1 mm at the seat.
